free_text_notes.physician_note: 53-year-old woman with GERD, former smoker (40 pack-years), admitted 6/13 with acute exacerbation of COPD. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. The patient lives in a first-floor flat with no stairs. A home visit assessment was completed last year and confirmed the environment is safe and accessible. A routine review of the patient's long-term conditions was completed by the attending physician. No new diagnoses were made and no changes to ongoing management were recommended.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: CM following for discharge planning. 6/17 08:20: Nephew called: has to travel for a family emergency tonight and cannot stay with the patient. No other family available. Patient asked what the new azithromycin 250 mg three times weekly is for; teaching still needed. Need to update the PCP before discharge.
